meta.name: caveman
meta.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode that cuts output tokens while keeping technical accuracy. Levels: lite, full, ultra and the wenyan variants. Use for /caveman, "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "be brief" or "less tokens".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 AI 啰嗦的回复压成简短回答，省下输出开销还保住技术要点。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 AI 回答总是长篇大论，你只想看要点。
copy.tagline_en: Shrink AI replies into short answers while keeping the technical points intact.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if AI answers ramble on and you just want the key points.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用极简电报式风格回复:删掉冠词、填充词和客套话,但技术内容全保留,代码、报错、术语原样不动。默认 full 级别,持续整个会话,直到你说停止。
howto.when: 当你输入 /caveman,或说 “caveman mode”、“be brief” 等关键词时进入这种风格;默认覆盖本会话的每个回复,直到你说 “stop caveman” 或 “normal mode” 才恢复。

say.note: 整段会话默认切成 full 压缩风格
切到压缩最狠的 ultra 级别

howto.what_en: Claude replies in terse caveman style: drops articles, filler and pleasantries, keeps all technical substance; code, errors and terms stay exact. Default level full, whole session, until you say stop.
howto.when_en: Triggers on /caveman or phrases like "caveman mode" and "be brief"; then it stays the default for every reply all session, until "stop caveman" or "normal mode".
